title: Rainforest animals
examples: What kinds of animals live in the rainforest?
Can you tell me about the rainforest layers?
Are jaguars big cats or monkeys?

explain.say: Today we will learn about amazing rainforest animals. We will also look at the different layers of the rainforest.
Jaguars are big spotted cats that live on the jungle floor. They are very strong hunters in the rainforest.
Brightly colored parrots love to fly through the canopy. They make very loud and cheerful sounds.
Sloths move very slowly through the trees. They spend most of their time hanging from branches.
Frogs have smooth skin and like to jump near water. They often live among the damp plants.
The rainforest has many layers, like a big cake. The canopy is the top layer where sunlight shines.

faq.q: Do all rainforest animals live only in the rainforest?
faq.a: No, some animals live in other places too. However, the rainforest is their natural home for many species.

faq.q: Are sloths always sleeping in the rainforest?
faq.a: Sloths spend most of their time in the trees, which are part of the rainforest. They need the leaves to eat.
asks: Where do sloths prefer to live?

faq.q: What is the difference between the canopy and the understory?
faq.a: The canopy is the top layer of leaves and branches. The understory is the layer below the canopy, where it is darker.
No, some animals like jaguars have camouflage spots. But parrots and frogs are often very bright.
asks: Can some animals be dull colored?

faq.q: What do jaguars eat in the rainforest?
faq.a: Jaguars are carnivores, which means they eat meat. They hunt other animals that live in the jungle.

facts: Rainforests are very wet and warm places.
The canopy layer is the highest layer of the forest.
Jaguars have unique spotted patterns on their skin.
Parrots use their strong beaks to crack nuts.

quiz.say: Which animal is known for moving very slowly through the trees?
quiz.why: Sloths are famous for their slow, deliberate movements while hanging in the trees.

wrong.0: Jaguars are powerful hunters and move much faster than sloths.
wrong.1: Parrots are birds and spend their time flying through the canopy.
wrong.2: Frogs are known for their quick, powerful jumps near the water.

quiz.say: If you are looking at the highest layer of leaves, you are in the:
quiz.why: The canopy is the top layer where most of the sunlight reaches the leaves.

wrong.1: The forest floor is the ground level, which is much darker.
wrong.2: The understory is the layer below the canopy, not the very top.
wrong.3: The emergent layer is the tallest, but the canopy describes the main leafy layer.

quiz.say: Which animal is best described as a colorful flyer?
quiz.why: Parrots are birds known for their vibrant colors and ability to fly.

wrong.1: Jaguars are mammals and are known for hunting on the ground.
wrong.2: Sloths are too slow to be called colorful flyers.
wrong.3: Frogs are amphibians and do not fly; they jump.
